## Before asking for a review

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint` and `pnpm build` pass in `web/`
- [ ] A change to a screen is drawn in `design/meel-wireframes.src.html` first, and a picture of it on a phone is added below
- [ ] A new or changed fact has its source and the day it was read, in my own words
- [ ] Nothing new shows a rider's name, contact or chat link without `data-private` or `data-private-block`
- [ ] No keys, passwords or personal details (names, emails, phone numbers) anywhere in the change
- [ ] The words on screen are plain, and the site still never says a road is open
